investment_policy_en:
Provides global exposure to dividend paying companies. Dividend payers outperform in the long term, dividend growers even more so. Dividend paying companies can protect against inflation over the long term.

Starting point is quality, not yield. Focus on companies generating persistently high returns on capital over the last decade.

Concentrated, typically equally-weighted portfolio of 35 stocks, which reduces stock specific risk and instils a strong sell discipline. Low turnover; minimum $1bn market cap; no benchmark-driven constraints on sector and regional weightings.

An equity fund investing primarily in global equities which provide a yield above the yield of the benchmark (MSCI World Index). The Fund is actively managed and uses the MSCI World Index as a comparator benchmark only.
